title.zh: Lighter计划成为首个申请美国合规牌照的Perp DEX项目，LIT24小时涨15%
title.en: Lighter计划成为首个申请美国合规牌照的Perp DEX项目，LIT24小时涨15%

current_state.zh: Lighter CEO Vladimir Novakovski said the perp DEX will formally apply with the CFTC next month for DCM and DCO licenses to serve US institutional clients, a first for an on-chain perp venue, sending LIT up as much as 15% to $3.76.
